text_en: Then he led me out into the outer court, toward the north, and he brought me to the chambers that were opposite the temple yard and opposite the building on the north.
text_cn: 以后他领我出来，到了内院的北部，引我来到位于空地前，向北的建筑物前的楼房那里。

text_en: The length of the building that was on the north side was one hundred cubits, and the width fifty cubits.
text_cn: 楼长一百肘，宽五十肘，

text_en: Across the twenty cubits that belonged to the inner court, and facing the pavement that belonged to the outer court, the chambers rose gallery by gallery in three stories.
text_cn: 是在内院空地与外院铺道的前面，走廊与走廊相对，楼房共有三层。

text_en: In front of the chambers was a passage on the inner side, ten cubits wide and one hundred cubits deep, and its entrances were on the north.
text_cn: 楼房前面有向内的过道，宽十肘，长一百肘，门都朝北。

text_en: Now the upper chambers were narrower, for the galleries took more away from them than from the lower and middle chambers in the building.
text_cn: 楼上层房屋比下层与中层的较窄，因为上层有走廊占去了面积。

text_en: For they were in three stories, and they had no pillars like the pillars of the outer court; for this reason the upper chambers were set back from the ground more than the lower and the middle ones.
text_cn: 因为楼房有三层，没有像外院所有的柱子，上层的比地上的下层和中层的较窄。

text_en: There was a wall outside parallel to the chambers, toward the outer court, opposite the chambers, fifty cubits long.
text_cn: 沿着楼房外边，靠着外院有道墙，长五十肘，立在楼房前面，

text_en: For the chambers on the outer court were fifty cubits long, while those opposite the temple were one hundred cubits long.
text_cn: 因为靠近外院的楼房长五十肘，靠近殿的楼房为一百肘。

text_en: At the foot of these chambers ran a passage that one entered from the east in order to enter them from the outer court.
text_cn: 在这些房屋下边，有个向东方的入口，为由外院来的人进入。

text_en: The width of the passage was fixed by the wall of the court. On the south also, opposite the vacant area and opposite the building, there were chambers
text_cn: 入口开在院墙的横面。在南边，在空隔地与建筑物的前面，也有楼房。

text_en: with a passage in front of them; they were similar to the chambers on the north, of the same length and width, with the same exits and arrangements and doors.
text_cn: 在楼房前面有相似北边的楼房所有的通道。长、宽、出路、位置和门与北边的楼房完全一样。

text_en: So the entrances of the chambers to the south were entered through the entrance at the head of the corresponding passage, from the east, along the matching wall.
text_cn: 在南边楼房的下边，在墙的开端，空地和建筑之前有一入口，为由东边来的人进入。

text_en: Then he said to me, “The north chambers and the south chambers opposite the vacant area are the holy chambers, where the priests who approach the Lord shall eat the most holy offerings; there they shall deposit the most holy offerings—the grain offering, the sin offering, and the guilt offering—for the place is holy.
text_cn: 以后他又对我说：“空地前南北两面的楼房，都是圣的，走近上主的司祭在那里吃至圣之物，并在那里存放至圣之物，如供物、赎罪祭与赎过祭肉，因为此地是圣的。

text_en: When the priests enter the holy place, they shall not go out of it into the outer court without laying there the vestments in which they minister, for these are holy; they shall put on other garments before they go near to the area open to the people. ”
text_cn: 司祭进入此处之后，不可直接由此圣地出去，前往外院，必须先在那里脱去自己供职时所穿的衣服，因为那些衣服也是圣的，应换上别的衣服，然后方可走近人民所在的地方。

text_en: When he had finished measuring the interior of the temple area, he led me out by the gate that faces east, and measured the temple area all around.
text_cn: 他测量完了圣殿的内部，就领我从面朝东的门出来，量了周围：

text_en: He measured the east side with the measuring reed, five hundred cubits by the measuring reed.
text_cn: 他用测量竿量了东边，依测量竿为五百肘；

text_en: Then he turned and measured the north side, five hundred cubits by the measuring reed.
text_cn: 他又量了北边，依测量竿为五百肘；

text_en: Then he turned and measured the south side, five hundred cubits by the measuring reed.
text_cn: 又量了南边，依测量竿为五百肘；

text_en: Then he turned to the west side and measured, five hundred cubits by the measuring reed.
text_cn: 又转身量了西边，依测量竿为五百肘。

text_en: He measured it on the four sides. It had a wall around it, five hundred cubits long and five hundred cubits wide, to make a separation between the holy and the common.
text_cn: 他周围量了四边环绕圣殿的垣墙，长五百肘，宽五百肘，为分开圣地与俗地。
